regime_context: Detector shows narrow leadership: only 5 of 17 themes are eligible, and rotation breadth is 'narrowing', with Banks and Energy as the only two strong positive leaders. The validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown control), not momentum rank; gate_helps is true for HK, so trend-eligibility carries risk-control weight. No theme has an ETF proxy except the two China Tech names (both deeply negative and ineligible), so the strongest leaders are unscorable in this market.
emerging_watch: Watching High-Dividend Blue Chips (rank 4, eligible, durability_bar 0.62, hurst_tag trend) as the possible third leg of an equity-income rotation: if its breadth (currently 0.5) sustains above 0.5 AND it overtakes Diversified Miners in score while staying eligible, that would confirm a broadening from Banks/Energy into defensive income. Retire the watch if it drops out of eligible or its breadth falls below 0.3.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: The leadership leg is trend-eligibility plus durability: Banks is rank-1, eligible (trend-gate), with the highest durability_bar (0.66) outside Energy, and positive breadth (0.615) showing participation rather than a single-stock spike. This is the only theme that is both the momentum leader AND passes the trend gate, which is the one validated risk-control leg. Crowding z=0.76 is not crowded. The condition here is not that Banks will beat the index, but that the trend-gate continues to admit it, so the lean is an overweight expression of staying with an established eligible trend, not a momentum call.
evidence: durability_bar 0.66 (highest of eligible leaders after Energy)
theses.dissent: Banks has mixed hurst_tag (not clean trend), durability_bar of 0.66 is moderate not high, and the rotation margin over Energy is only 0.127 — a thin lead that could flip on any rate or property-credit headline, given unscheduled_share is 0.75 in the macro backdrop.

falsifier.text: Banks drops out of eligible (trend gate flips to false) or Energy overtakes it in rank and rotation margin widens to >0.2 by the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the strongest durability/trend-health profile in the ranks: eligibility true, durability_bar 0.81 (highest of any theme), hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.8 (broadest of the top-ranked). It is the clear challenger (score 1.183, margin 0.127 behind Banks). As a second eligible trend leader with superior trend-health metrics, it is a second eligible trend that the trend-gate (the validated risk-control leg) admits. Conviction is low only because trend-following in a commodity-linked H-share basket is more volatile and the margin over Banks is thin.
theses.dissent: Energy is a commodity-cyclical H-share theme — an oil/coal macro swing can cut it sharply regardless of trend-health; durability_bar can stay high while price mean-reverts on a supply headline. Scorable false means no clean proxy to verify the call, so the check is hard.

falsifier.text: Energy's durability_bar drops below 0.6 or its score falls below High-Dividend Blue Chips (score 0.907) before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: This is the only scorable negative theme (etf_proxy 3033.HK), and the trend-gate's validated edge is risk control via avoiding broken trends. China Tech & Internet is rank 14, score -0.855, ineligible (trend gate failed), durability_bar 0.16 (near-zero staying power), hurst_tag 'mean-revert' (wrong regime for a trend follower), and breadth 0.053 (no participation). The lean is not a short — it is an avoid: the one validated edge says the absolute-trend gate should keep you out of broken trends, and this is the clearest broken trend in the book.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag means it could bounce hard on a China stimulus or platform-regulation reprieve headline; unscheduled_share 0.75 means macro surprises are dominant, and an avoid on a scorable proxy could miss a sharp relief rally. Fading by staying out still has opportunity cost.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK becomes trend-eligible (China Tech & Internet turns eligible) by the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
